repo.name: patched-kushion
repo.description: Patched and externally sourced Android applications

apps.description:
This is the stable non-root patched-kushion build of KouMusik.

Current patch bundle: Morphe (MorpheApp/morphe-patches)
Patch frontend: MorpheApp/morphe-desktop
Upstream package: com.google.android.apps.youtube.music
Stable package identity: de.kwoo.shion.music

The patch implementation may change in a later release without changing this package identity. Build configuration and APK provenance are published in the source repository.

This is a modified patched-kushion build, not an official Morphe release and not affiliated with Morphe.
The Morphe NOTICE required by its patch license is included in the APK and source repository.
apps.name: KouMusik
